For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic

1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK Hiring of Vehicle for Transportation of Meteorological Instruments, Equipment and Official Mat erials 1. The service provider shall provide suitable vehicles, for transportation of meteorological instrument s, 2. The vehicle provided must be in good running condition, properly maintained, roadworthy and suita ble for safe transportation of the equipment/materials. 3. The service provider shall ensure timely availability of the vehicle at the designated reporting point and transportation of materials to the specified destination without unnecessary delay. 4. The driver deployed shall possess a valid driving licence, adequate driving experience and knowledg e of the local routes and terrain. 5. The service provider shall be responsible for the safety and security of the vehicle, driver and transp ortation arrangements. Any loss or damage to the materials attributable to negligence or mishandli ng by the service provider shall be borne by the service provider. 6. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable charges, including driver charges, fuel, maintena nce, insurance, taxes, toll charges and other incidental expenses, as specified in the financial bid. N o additional payment shall be admissible beyond the accepted rates. 7. Payment shall be made on the basis of actual vehicle deployment and satisfactory completion of th e assigned transportation work, duly certified by the competent/authorized officer, subject to submi ssion of the requisite bill and supporting documents. 8. The service provider shall comply with all applicable Motor Vehicle Rules, statutory requirements an d terms and conditions prescribed on GeM. 9. In case of failure to provide the vehicle as per the requirement or any deficiency in service, the Dep artment reserves the right to make alternative arrangements at the risk and cost of the service prov ider, besides taking appropriate action as per the terms and conditions of the contract. 10. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The vehicle shall be deployed on 18.12.2026 at Meteorological Centre, Srinagar, for transportation o f meteorological equipment/materials to Rajouri, Jammu & Kashmir. 2. The vehicle shall be a suitable goods carrier with adequate loading capacity and sufficient space for safe transportation of the equipment.

3. The vehicle must report at Meteorological Centre, Srinagar, at the time specified by the Department and shall proceed to Rajouri as per the instructions of the authorized official. 4. The vehicle shall be in good mechanical condition, roadworthy and properly maintained. All necessa ry vehicle documents, including Registration Certificate, Fitness Certificate, Insurance and Pollution Under Control Certificate, shall be valid. 5. The driver must possess a valid driving licence and have adequate experience in driving on hilly and challenging road conditions. 6. The quoted rate shall be inclusive of fuel, driver charges, maintenance, toll taxes, parking charges, applicable taxes and all other incidental expenses. No extra payment shall be admissible over and a bove the accepted bid rate. 7. The service provider shall ensure safe loading, transportation and unloading of the meteorological e quipment at the designated destination in Rajouri. 8. The service provider shall be responsible for any loss or damage to the equipment arising due to ne gligence, improper handling or unsafe transportation attributable to the service provider. 9. The vehicle shall not be changed or substituted without prior approval of the Department. 10. Payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion of the assigned transportation work an d submission of the bill, duly verified by the authorized official. 11. In case of failure to provide the vehicle on the scheduled date or unsatisfactory service, the Depart ment reserves the right to make alternative arrangements at the risk and cost of the service provide r, as per applicable contractual provisions. 12. The Department reserves the right to cancel the requirement in case of administrative exigencies or adverse weather/road conditions, subject to the applicable terms and conditions of the GeM contract . .
